l.i: Pastores stolidi nunc sunt ludibria vulgi,
Nec tamen à sannis temperat aula sibi.
ἀνδρῶν, Pastores ! merces arce reposita poli est.

page.notes: The engraving (between the title and the verse) shows a scene: on the left a man in a wide-brimmed hat and cloak with raised hands, a figure with a hat pointing upward, and an old bearded man in a long coat and cap on the right, with a town and hills behind and a sky of cloud streaks above. No printed text is inside the picture. The Greek word in the third verse line is hard to read on the scan; the letters after Κοιμ are uncertain. The verse has no full stop after "vulgi," and the line-end punctuation is as printed. The catchword "Iure" is in italic at the lower right.
